# Socket commands

116 operations run as a socket command, with the same scope, validation and
errors as their REST route. A command is sent as
`command { op, sessionId?, params?, idempotencyKey? }`: `op` is the name of the first column,
`sessionId` stands for the `:sessionId` of the route, and `params` holds the other path
parameters (listed here) together with the body or the query of the route. The ack, the rate
limits and the handshake are in [`websocket.md`](websocket.md); the fields of each `params` are
those of the operation in [`openapi.json`](openapi.json).

## REST only

41 operations have no socket command, each for a reason:

| Operation | REST | Reason |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `apiKeys.create` | `POST /v1/api-keys` | admin: keys and sessions are managed over REST, never over a long-lived socket |
| `apiKeys.list` | `GET /v1/api-keys` | admin: keys and sessions are managed over REST, never over a long-lived socket |
| `apiKeys.revoke` | `DELETE /v1/api-keys/{id}` | admin: keys and sessions are managed over REST, never over a long-lived socket |
| `apiKeys.rotate` | `POST /v1/api-keys/{id}/rotate` | admin: keys and sessions are managed over REST, never over a long-lived socket |
| `inboundHooks.create` | `POST /v1/sessions/{sessionId}/inbound-hooks` | configuration: webhooks and inbound hooks carry secrets and are managed over REST |
| `inboundHooks.list` | `GET /v1/sessions/{sessionId}/inbound-hooks` | configuration: webhooks and inbound hooks carry secrets and are managed over REST |
| `inboundHooks.revoke` | `DELETE /v1/sessions/{sessionId}/inbound-hooks/{hookId}` | configuration: webhooks and inbound hooks carry secrets and are managed over REST |
| `inboundHooks.send` | `POST /v1/hooks/inbound/{token}` | public: its credential is the token in the URL, and a socket has its own key |
| `messages.media` | `GET /v1/sessions/{sessionId}/messages/{messageId}/media` | binary: it answers the bytes of the file, which an ack of JSON cannot carry |
| `sendPolicy.get` | `GET /v1/sessions/{sessionId}/send-policy` | configuration: changes how the gateway behaves, a decision for the operator and not for a conversation |
| `sendPolicy.update` | `PUT /v1/sessions/{sessionId}/send-policy` | configuration: changes how the gateway behaves, a decision for the operator and not for a conversation |
